parameters.query:
-- Drafts each clinic's last closed period in its own timezone. Includes shows
-- marked late from earlier periods, tops up to the contract minimum, then
-- applies credits. Sent invoices are never touched.
SELECT c.name                                             AS clinic,
       r->>'result'                                       AS result,
       i.shows_count,
       to_char(i.total_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990.00') AS total
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(pps.draft_invoices(NULL::date, 'n8n')) AS r
  JOIN pps.clinics c ON c.clinic_id = r->>'clinic_id'
  JOIN pps.invoices i ON i.invoice_id = r->>'invoice_id'
 WHERE r->>'result' IN ('drafted', 'refreshed')
 ORDER BY c.name;
